title: View (ISO/IEC/IEEE 42010:2022)
description: An expression of the architecture from the perspective of a Viewpoint. It addresses one or more Concerns.

viewpoint.description: A viewpoint of the active catalog, for example enterprise or computational

addresses_concerns.description: The concerns that this view addresses (CON-*). ISO 42010 §5.4

models.description: The models of the view. SP3 MUST have a static model AND a dynamic model (Art. VIII).

notation.description: for example UML, IDEF0, C4, mermaid, text

path.description: The relative path to the artifact that contains the model

confirmed.description: A view with status=recovered MUST have a human confirmation before it goes into a baseline
